title: Hit pop Up
description: HitPop brings your Minecraft combat to life with dynamic floating damage numbers, weapon-specific hit particles, satisfying combo counters, and special critical/block visual indicators.
body:
HitPop
======

HitPop is a lightweight combat enhancement mod for Minecraft that adds dynamic, floating combat numbers and weapon-specific hit visuals. It is designed to make combat feel more responsive and tactile while staying clean and optimized. 

All rendering is handled on the client side using Minecraft's modern rendering system, ensuring maximum compatibility and smooth performance.
